declarations.description:
The primary site header component that accepts various slotted header components and controls their visibility in the nav tray.

By default, background images are set via global CSS properties. Without the image-url or background-image-url attributes, the header will have no background art.

The image-url and font-url attributes are conveniences for apps without a js entry point to make those calls from.
They act on the whole document, not just the header, so use one or the other, not both.

The header also sets --page-width on the document with a {@link PageWidthController }, for layout classes such as l-full-width.
Set the no-page-width attribute to turn this off.

The header bar (UC Davis logo, inline menu and tray toggles) is sticky: it stays fixed to the top of the screen, and shrinks once the page scrolls.
The branding bar scrolls away as usual. The header reserves the bar's space itself, so the page needs no sticky-header class or padding,
and it sets scroll-padding-top on the page (to --sticky-header-scroll-offset), so #hash links land below the bar.
Set the no-sticky attribute to turn this off.

declarations.description:
A single-level main menu, shown inline in the cork-header bar. For sites with only a few top-level links. Add it as a child of the {@link cork-header } element.

The header shows it on larger screens, in place of the menu tray toggle.
Smaller screens use the menu tray, so the site still also needs a cork-primary-nav.

The links can be written in the element, or copied from the header's cork-primary-nav with copyFromPrimaryNav, so they're only written once.
Only top-level items are shown: sub menus and fields are ignored.

declarations.description:
Renders markdown as sanitized HTML in the light DOM (no shadow root), so it inherits styles.

- The markdown comes from the markdown property, or from a child script tag with type="text/markdown", 
which is reread whenever its text changes. 
- Uses marked and DOMPurify packages, for parsing and sanitization. Behavior can be customized via markedOptions property.
- Headings get GitHub-style ids (via marked-gfm-heading-id), with headingIdPrefix in front, e.g. '## Slots' gets id="md-slots".
The prefix stops DOMPurify from removing ids that match DOM properties, such as 'children' or 'title'.
Relative links with a #hash get the same prefix added, so `[Slots](#slots)` and `[Slots](other.md#slots)` still point at the heading.
declarations.name: CorkMarkdown

members.name: markedOptions
members.description: Options for marked package, merged over the defaults: {breaks: true, gfm: true}, and custom list and table renderers that add certain theme classes. Takes the same object as marked.use(), including renderer methods. See https://marked.js.org/using_advanced. Or an array of them, applied in order, e.g. to add an extension such as marked-highlight alongside your own options. Property only.

declarations.description:
A simple search form with optional facet buttons. Can be added as a child of the {@link cork-header } element, or of a {@link cork-search-tray }.

On submit:

- With formAction set, the form submits natively. Otherwise it fires a cork-search event for the app to handle.
- The search button submits as submitParam=Submit, and a facet button as its name=value, so the request says which one was used.
- After a search, it asks a parent cork-header to close its nav tray, unless keepTrayOpen is set.
declarations.name: CorkSearchForm
